lexical.scope: Nine selected source representations replaced simultaneously; all other representations and the common candidate universe remain fixed. Neighbor changes are descriptive, not independent statistical trials.

semantic.scope: Nine selected source representations replaced simultaneously; all other representations and the common candidate universe remain fixed. Neighbor changes are descriptive, not independent statistical trials.

methods.selection: Previously frozen nine full recordings: five retained OmNa audios plus shortest eligible official Bashar, Tracy, Multidimensional Soul and Athina recordings; not a random sample.
methods.representations: Frozen canonical TF-IDF vocabulary/IDF and masked full-body MiniLM weights/pooling. Only nine new texts and five unmatched old ASRs encoded; four old canonical vectors reused.
methods.counterfactual: One simultaneous replacement of the nine canonical representations; all other 484 vectors remain unchanged. This is a sensitivity calculation, not adoption of new editions.
methods.same_audio_scope: Old and new recognition editions from the exact same retained encoded audio; decoding/window/model settings differ. This does not isolate model architecture causally.
methods.canonical_scope: Five selected OmNa primary editions are publisher-written messages, not old ASRs; their comparison is explicitly confounded by text origin/editorial treatment.
methods.negation_cues: Casefolded lexical no/not/never/nor/cannot or token ending n't; surface cue counts, not resolved logical negation.
methods.number_cues: Digit sequences plus listed number/ordinal words; lexical counters, not checked factual claims. Rates use lexical-token denominator.
methods.tie_break: Descending cosine, then stable canonical source ID

limitations: No listening reference, WER, human accuracy measurement or correctness ranking is available.
Similarity and stable neighbors do not imply identical answers, preserved qualifiers, truth, or verified entity identities.
Negation and number cue differences can reflect recognition, wording, editing, punctuation or scope; no automatic semantic judgment follows.
The small purposive set and dependent neighbors do not support population-level accuracy claims or significance tests.
Old evidence cards and locators remain bound to their original editions. No card, claim or interpretation is automatically transferred.
